name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (battle/spell domain). 'execute_offensive' = offensive spell worker; 'full_screen_flash' is the distinguishing second-animation variant (vs sibling fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227 which uses overlay_blink). Name accurately reflects body. No Ghidra address residue. No domain ID to preserve. Keep.
purpose: Generic offensive spell worker (full-screen-flash animation variant, spell ids 4-7): plays the impact + full-screen-flash animations, deducts caster MP, then applies magic damage to every target in the byte array (miss indicator on 0, else damage number glyph 0x5E).
logic_summary: Resets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx=0; calls fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster,spell_id,n_targets,p_targets) then fd2_animate_spell_full_screen_flash(same args); fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster,spell_id). Loops iter=0..n_targets-1: target_id=((uint8*)p_targets)[iter]; damage=fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id,spell_id); if damage!=0 -> fd2_show_damage_number(damage,0x5E,target_id) else fd2_show_miss_indicator(target_id). Closes with fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). In binary the loop-exit JGE 0x2141E falls into the Pattern-A shared epilogue @ 0x21190 (no explicit RET); src inlines it as the two trailing calls. Byte-identical to sibling fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell @ 0x21227 except the 2nd animation (full_screen_flash vs overlay_blink). Ghidra __CHK(0x24,...) stack probe is the Watcom prologue, not game logic, and is correctly omitted in src.
